grid_study.note: 3-rung ladder, all with resolved boundary layers (add_layers=True, target y+ 30), sdk/scripts/naca4412_credential_repair.py. Cd and Cl were NOT monotonic: medium->fine Cd fell 25% (0.024478->0.018262), fine->finer Cd moved <1% (0.018262->0.018327) but Cl swung back up 19% (0.209547->0.250179). No Richardson/observed-order fit performed on non-asymptotic data. The finer (1,849,113-cell) rung independently failed the lab's own mesh non-orthogonality gate (74.96 deg, gate 70 deg) and achieved only 58.3% of its target boundary-layer thickness (vs ~94% on the other two rungs) -- degraded, not improved, at the largest cell count -- the leading suspect for the non-monotonicity. The graded rung (fine, 645,251 cells) is the only one passing both mesh gates with full layer coverage. || SUPERSEDED IN PART, 2026-08-02: the clause naming the finer rung's 74.96 max non-orthogonality as 'degraded, not improved, at the largest cell count' and 'the leading suspect for the non-monotonicity' does not survive measurement. 74.96 is the mesh-quality dictionary's own relaxed ceiling (external_aero.py:403, relaxed { maxNonOrtho 75; }), not a reading of how bad the mesh got. Replicate C of the layered replicate family reaches 74.962443 at 653,090 cells -- a third of the finer rung's cell count -- against the finer rung's 74.962218, agreeing to 3.0e-06 relative, by changing the background blockMesh divisions alone. The other three meshes in that family sit at 64.958-64.990, just under the STRICT maxNonOrtho 65. Every mesh here except the medium rung is pinned to one of its own two dictionary limits, so this field reports which constraint branch snappyHexMesh ended on. The rest of the note stands. Evidence: demo-output/website/campaign/W3_NACA4412_LAYERED_REPLICATES.md section 6. The check that this is not a 4412 quirk has been run rather than left as a claim: across all 70 log.checkMesh files under /home/ubuntu/certonomous-runs, 8 snappyHexMesh meshes sit at 64.64-64.99 (including the B-52's finer2-uq 64.646803 and rung7-uq 64.640997, a different body under the same meshQualityDict) and 3 at 74.31-74.96, while ~53 sit genuinely below both and the 6 above 75 are externally supplied grids with no snappyHexMesh log at all. The lab's 70-degree gate sits BETWEEN the two ceilings, so for any mesh hard enough to press on the constraint it returns pass-at-65 or fail-at-75 and nothing in between.

mesh_construction_replicates.verdict_effect: All four buildable meshes read OUT of the +/-9.56% band, +16.35% to +32.54%, all on the same side, so NOT VALIDATED is reproducible across mesh construction. The VALUE is not: the graded 0.018263 is the MINIMUM of its own replicate family, i.e. the most favourable of the four.

mesh_construction_scatter_vs_resolution.what: The SAME four background blockMesh division triples rebuilt at the two rungs either side of the graded one, everything else byte-identical, 4 ranks scotch. Twelve meshes, three rungs, all converged. D (35 58 20) is excluded at every rung because locationInMesh lands on a block-face plane at even span division counts, which is a property of the divisions and so holds at every refinement.
mesh_construction_scatter_vs_resolution.controls: refinement 3 A reproduces the stored medium rung's 263,359 cells exactly and its Cd to 2.6e-04 relative; refinement 5 A reproduces the stored finer rung's 1,849,113 cells, its Cd to 5.7e-05, and its max non-orthogonality, average and 797 severely non-orthogonal faces to every printed digit.
mesh_construction_scatter_vs_resolution.answer: Refinement 5 is a resolution at which this body's drag can be STATED: Cd = 0.018302 +/- 0.000385 (half-range over four independently constructed meshes at 1.79-1.88 M cells), +16.6% from the reference 0.015696, mesh-construction scatter 0.51x the band half-width against 1.69x at the graded rung.
mesh_construction_scatter_vs_resolution.verdict_effect: NOT VALIDATED holds on twelve of twelve meshes across three resolutions, all outside the band on the same side, +13.61% to +65.42%. The scatter is NOT monotone in refinement -- 5.82, 12.74, 4.20 percent -- so the graded rung is the worst of the three, and a one-rung measurement could not have shown that. At refinement 5 the published triple is no longer an extremum of its own family: it sits second of four, 0.13% from the family mean, against being the MINIMUM at refinement 4 and the MAXIMUM on the NACA 0012.
mesh_construction_scatter_vs_resolution.layer_coverage_is_a_property_of_the_rung: This record blamed the finer rung's 58.3% of target layer thickness on that mesh. Every refinement-5 replicate reads 57.2-60.2%, achieving about 6 of 12 layers, against 94.2-94.5% at refinements 3 and 4. The rung under-resolves layers on every mesh built at it, and that -- not non-orthogonality -- is the next thing to look at for the +16.6% gap.
mesh_construction_scatter_vs_resolution.cost_note: Priced from one mesh first as the item required: replicate B at refinement 5 measured 32.61 core-min, predicting 130.4 for a family of four. The family cost 154.26, a 1.18x overrun ON A MEASURED BASIS, outside the 1.051x the lab's measured-basis pairs had never exceeded. The cause is meshing, not the solve: snappyHexMesh reported 934.2, 1045.0, 1058.1 and 1683.84 s across the four, a 1.80x spread, with the control triple needing 51 layer-addition iterations against B's 25. A single mesh prices a rung only where meshing cost is not itself construction-sensitive.

mesh_quality_regrade_2026_08_02.reading: THE GRADED RUNG'S OWN mesh_gates_pass true is not a measurement: 64.989619 is 0.010 deg under the strict maxNonOrtho 65 the recipe wrote, so the 70 deg gate could not have failed it. What survives on an unpinned reading is the extent, and the extent is clean -- 0 of 2,008,367 faces above 70 deg. The pass stands; the evidence for it is the face count, not the maximum.

rungs.mesh_gate_failure: non-orthogonality 74.96 deg exceeds the 70 deg gate || REGRADED 2026-08-02 on a gate that does not read a pinned number: 74.962218 is the meshQualityDict RELAXED ceiling (maxNonOrtho 75, external_aero.py:403), so it measures which constraint branch snappyHexMesh ended on and not how far this mesh degraded, and the 70 deg gate -- which sits between the strict 65 and the relaxed 75 -- has no resolution against it. The unpinned reading of the same defect is EXTENT: 797 of 5,740,702 faces are severely non-orthogonal (>70 deg), a fraction of 1.39e-04, against exactly 0 of 2,008,367 on the graded fine rung and 0 of 820,472 on the medium rung. The failure is therefore real in kind and small in extent, and the magnitude 74.96 carries none of that information.
